summary: Pinnacle Acquisition Corp, a blank-check SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its initial public offering of 20,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, raising $200 million, and a simultaneous private placement of 225,000 units to its sponsor at $10.00 per unit. The filing also describes a first amendment to the underwriting agreement waiving the $0.30 deferred underwriting discount on 2,250,000 units purchased by sponsor affiliates, capping the maximum deferred discount at $5,325,000 (or $6,225,000 with over-allotment). This is a routine IPO closing disclosure, not a special-situation event.
